answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21210 Country: India Title: My Sister have performed Istekara for her marriage proposal, and she saw in her dream a flower specifically a lotus flower and also had a feeling of satisfaction the next morning she woke up, what one should conclude with this dream please advice. Question: Salam Walaikum, My Sister have performed Istekara for her marriage proposal, and she saw in her dream a flower specifically a lotus flower and also had a feeling of satisfaction the next morning she woke up, what one should conclude with this dream please advice. Thanks Brother Ahmed. Answer ID: 21210 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 460/582/H=1431) If there is no hindrance in nikah as per the Shariah, then the dream and in the result of istikharah clearly point out that the proposal should be accepted. In-sha-Allah, accepting it would be better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
